paragraphs: Rabbah bar Sheila. Berakhot 2, beginning of b; Hullin 132b. Rava bar Sheila: Shabbat 120b, 156a; Menahot 87a; Sotah 35b; Zevahim 38b. Rabbah bar bar Sheila: Yoma 39, beginning of b; the second ‘bar’ is a scribal error. Heilprin lists Rav Adda bar Ahavah as the alternative in Zevahim 48b. The checked Bavli names Rav Adda first and Rabbah bar Sheila as the alternative. He flogged a man who had intercourse with a gentile woman, etc. (Our reading assigns this episode to R' Sheila. Yuhasin brings it both here and there, under R' Sheila, granting one deed to two parties.) He encountered Elijah and asked, ‘What does the Holy One, blessed be He, do?’ He replied, ‘He states teachings from the rabbis' mouths, but does not state from R' Meir's mouth, because he learned from Aher.’ He said, ‘R' Meir ate its contents and discarded its peel,’ etc. He told him, ‘Now’—the Holy One, blessed be He, has listened to your voice—‘He says, “Meir My son says thus: when a person is in distress, what does the Divine Presence say? My head is heavy,”’ Hagigah 15b. Ta'anit 8b: ‘A day of rain is hard.’ In Bava Metzia 85a, Ein Yaakov has Mar bar Rav Sheila, a scribal error for Rabbah. Also Rav Aha bar Yaakov; R' Ila; R' Ilai. ‘Rabbah of Rav Sheila's household said’—‘of the household’ is a scribal error for ‘bar’—‘When Rav Dimi came’: Shabbat 7a. R' Zeira said that Rabbah bar Sheila said. Gittin 26b: R' Abba bar Sheila said; there, 81b: bar She'ilta. The new Talmud editions did not correct it. In Ketubot 40a and Gittin 26b, the chain continues through Rav Hamnuna the Elder (see his entry), who reports Rav Adda bar Ahavah in Rav’s name. Also R' Hagga. R’ Hiyya the Tall appeared before him in a court case. He reported teachings of Rav Hisda (Shabbat 7a and 33a). He reported a teaching of Rav Hisda, or according to one version Rav Yosef (Hullin 102a). He asked Rav Hisda: Shabbat 81, end of a. Rabbah bar Sheila said that Rav Mattana said that Shmuel said: Hullin 42b; Arakhin 10, end of b; Niddah 27, beginning of a; Hagigah 23a. Rava bar Sheila said that Rav Nahman said: Bava Batra 155b. Before Rava for judgment: see R' Hiyya the Tall. See below, Ravina bar Sheila; perhaps they are one, but this needs examination.
